rules.rationale: Base equation defining the structural all-integer predicate on the empty value sequence.
Recursive constructor equation defining allInts by checking the head and descending through the tail.
Defines the named projection-definedness predicate to be the existing integer-sort observation isInt.

Adds an unproved characterization of the definedness of K's partial Val-to-Int cast; Stage 1 imports this simplification while proving its claims and never proves the exact rule in a module that omits it.
Guarded defining equation for the new total projection proof term in terms of the built-in partial cast.
Symbolic macro orientation of the same guarded definition, replacing a defined partial cast by its named total-projection proof term.
Collapse equation defining total projection on an argument already statically sorted as Int.
Normalization equation for nested occurrences of the named total-projection proof term.
Adds a simplification bridge from dynamically sorted integer comparison to projected Int comparison; its exact statement is not separately proved before the rule is imported.
Adds a simplification bridge from dynamically sorted unary negation to projected Int subtraction; its exact statement is not separately proved before the rule is imported.
Negative branch of the guarded equation defining integer magnitude.
Nonnegative branch of the guarded equation defining integer magnitude.
Definitional naming equation that represents the supplied nonnegative Int2String/strToCodes result by the opaque proof term decimalCodes.

Adds an unproved guarded simplification for the existing str builtin on a dynamic Val and connects its observable result to decimalCodes; Stage 1 contains no prior exact connection proof without this rule.
Base equation defining the allDigitCodes structural predicate on the empty code sequence.
Recursive constructor equation defining allDigitCodes by the ASCII digit bounds and tail predicate.

Trusted additional fact asserting that every opaque decimalCodes result for a nonnegative integer consists only of digit codes; it is explicitly the Stage 1 value-level primitive contract and is not separately proved.
Base equation defining the digit-code sum of an empty sequence.
Structural recurrence defining digit-code sum by adding the current code minus ASCII zero.
Base equation defining chooseFirst on an empty remaining code sequence.
Recursive zero-accumulator branch defining chooseFirst from the current digit code.
Recursive nonzero-accumulator branch of the chooseFirst definition, retaining the chosen value while descending through the tail.
Base equation defining lastCode when no codes remain.
Structural recurrence defining lastCode by retaining the current head and descending through the tail.
Negative guarded branch defining signedDigitSum from the digit summary and first-digit correction.
Nonnegative guarded branch defining signedDigitSum as the ordinary digit-code sum.
Base equation defining countNumsSpec on the empty value sequence.
Guarded structural recurrence defining countNumsSpec for an integer head and the remaining tail.
Complementary guarded recurrence completing the total countNumsSpec definition for a noninteger head.
